title: The vendor Credit Terms dropdown lists active terms, with no Default tag
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 10 days after the invoice date, is the default for new customers. Its own term {Term-B}, due on day 5 of the following month, is active. Net 50 is deactivated and every other standard term is active. Other shop terms (from other tests) may also be offered.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-01 Ten and {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-01 Fifth.
  • Starting screen: Parts, Vendors.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Vendor" window opens.
  • Step 2: it lists the active terms in the page order: COD first, Due on Receipt second, then the Net terms by days with {Term-A} after Net 7 and before Net 15, then Net 15 to Net 120 (Net 50 missing), then the day-of-the-following-month terms with {Term-B} among them, and Credit Hold last. No item carries a "Default" tag (not even {Term-A}).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R1: “The Credit Terms dropdown on New Vendor and Edit Vendor lists the shop's active terms, standard and its own, in the S1-R5 order.”
  • S6-R2: “New Vendor starts on COD, as today. The shop's default does not apply to vendors, and the vendor dropdown shows no "Default" tag.”
  • S6-N2: “Inactive terms are never offered to a vendor not already on them.”
  • S1-R5: “Rows are listed in this order on both tabs: COD; Due on Receipt; every Net term (standard and the shop's own) by number of days, lowest first; every "day of the following month" term by day, lowest first; any other term A to Z; Credit Hold last. Ties sort A to Z by name. The same order is used in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”
  • Key Decisions: “One default and one term list per organization, shared by customers and vendors.”
  • Feature Overview: “Customers and vendors share one term list. The shop's default applies to new customers only; new vendors keep starting on COD.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "7 Vendors" ("New Vendor: starts on COD, picker with your terms", "Edit Vendor: the picker with your terms"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p7-02-new-vendor-starts-on-cod-picker-with-your-terms.png
  • ct-p7-04-edit-vendor-the-picker-with-your-terms.png

The design's own words:

  • “One term list for customers and vendors: the picker offers the active terms in the S1-R5 order, Credit Hold last. Deactivated terms are not offered.”
  • “The same list and order as New Vendor and the customer pickers (S6-R1).”
